name: Ash Varga
bio: New to the Driftline, riding a second-hand hover-bike bought on Guild credit. Owes 8,000 credits, rides like the debt is chasing — because it is. Talks dry, rides kind, and is constitutionally incapable of leaving a sealed crate alone.
appearance: Lean courier in a sun-faded rust riding coat, wrap-around amber goggles, scarf over the lower face, hair doing whatever the wind negotiated. The bike: a patched, beloved second-hand hover.
voice: Dry internal monologue, understated on the radio. Humor at own expense. Gets quieter, not louder, when things get big.

greetings: Varga. I have a bike, a debt, and excellent availability.
barks: I meant to hit that. It's a technique.
mission: There's a crate on this manifest that doesn't exist. I checked twice. Then I stopped checking, which felt healthier.
Any crate, any storm, any door. Somebody woke up ambitious when they wrote the creed.
radio: Saltmouth, Varga. Traffic is light. Traffic is me.
Note to self: glass is faster than sand, and twice as smug.
The desert's doing that thing again where it's beautiful on purpose. Suspicious.
